# AccuWeather

> AccuWeather is a global weather forecasting platform delivering hyperlocal forecasts, air quality data, and weather-driven advertising solutions powered by proprietary technologies like RealFeel® and MinuteCast®.

AccuWeather provides comprehensive weather intelligence for consumers and businesses worldwide, combining advanced forecasting capabilities with targeted advertising solutions across multiple industry verticals including automotive, retail, healthcare, and finance.

## Key Topics

- RealFeel®
- MinuteCast®
- Superior Accuracy™
- Weather Forecast
- Local Weather
- Hourly Forecast
- Daily Forecast
- Air Quality
- Global Forecast
- Weather Radar
- Advertising Solutions
- Industry Verticals
- Weather Targeting
- Automotive
- Retail

## Weather Forecasting

- [Local, National, & Global Daily Weather Forecast | AccuWeather](http://sirocco.accuweather.com/): AccuWeather's main weather forecasting platform with local, hourly, daily forecasts and air quality data

## Advertising Solutions

- [Advertising Solutions by Industry | AccuWeather Advertising](https://advertising.accuweather.com/solutions-by-vertical/): AccuWeather's advertising solutions tailored for automotive, retail, healthcare, finance, and other verticals

## Developer Resources

- [Storybook.Web](https://storybook.accuweather.com/): AccuWeather's design system and component library documentation for UI development
